description: Guidance for generating reflected-input (textual reflection / potential XSS) validation strategies over a single HTTP response, not a browser.
consider: response content type (HTML vs JSON vs other - encoding expectations differ)
whether the marker is echoed at all, and if so, raw vs HTML-entity-escaped
security headers already observed as present or absent (e.g. Content-Security-Policy)
that this is a textual check and cannot confirm script execution in a real DOM
references: OWASP Web Security Testing Guide - Testing for Reflected Cross Site Scripting
CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation
example_patterns: a short, uniquely-identifiable marker containing an HTML-meaningful character, checked for raw vs escaped reflection
